## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks, prerequisite read for the Landau fan

Raw traces precede the FFTs below. Both completed with stable drain current (9.81–9.94 nA), sample T 1.165–1.292 K, |gate current| <0.22 nA, and |Rxx| <0.59 kOhm versus 5 kOhm full scale. Region is the sole wired pair B_1–B_2; the two CNP ridges from run 5 remain a spatial-density confound.

Electron run 6 (n=+3.2e12, D≈0) contains candidates near 7.3, 14.8, 22.3 and 29.4 T; frequency proximity to harmonics alone cannot screen them. Hole run 7 (n=−1.2e12) has near 4.7, 6.6 and 12.3 T content, with close tones and limited allowed hole density. **Call: stacking uninformative at this stage.** A density trajectory and global scale fit are required, including ABAB and adjacent-N overlays, and the F_L-tone origin checks in `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Verify.

Default electron `sdh_onset` reports 0.30 T, censored; restricting to the adequately sampled B≥1 T segment still reports a censored 1 T edge. Below 1 T, the 50 mT grid was background-only and does not Nyquist the full frequency set. Thus neither result pins a physical onset. Next is a short low-field electron extension, then one cost-floored electron fan; no low-field absence claim is supported yet. The hole-side helper onset is 0.714 T, but its accessible density window cannot reach the clean high-density 4L template separation.

from pathlib import Path
import json, sys
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
out = Path('hera_scratch')
results = {}
for i,n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:
 r=open_run(f'data/{i}')
 plot_raw(r); plt.savefig(out/f'spot_{i}_raw.png',dpi=150); plt.show()
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col('sr0_X')/-1e6; R=r.col('sr1_X')/I
 order=np.argsort(B); B=B[order]; R=R[order]
 print('RUN',i,'R min/max',R.min(),R.max(),'I nA',np.percentile(I,[0,50,100])*1e9,'T',np.percentile(r.col('T_sample'),[0,100]))
 print('leak pA',*[np.percentile(r.col(c),[0,50,100])*1e12 for c in ['k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']])
 on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000); print(on.summary())
 results[str(i)]={'onset':on.onset_b,'summary':on.summary(),'Rmax':float(R.max())}
 fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4)); ax[0].plot(B,R); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Rxx (ohm)',title=f'Run {i}, n={n:+g}')
 for cut in [on.onset_b,1.5,2.,3.]:
  for deg in [3,5]:
   f,p=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(cut,10),bg_degree=deg,nfft=4096,log=False)
   peaks,_=find_peaks(p[0]); peaks=sorted(peaks,key=lambda k:p[0,k],reverse=True)
   print('FFT',i,cut,deg,[(round(float(f[k]),2),round(float(p[0,k]),3)) for k in peaks[:6]])
   ax[1].plot(f,p[0],label=f'{cut:.2f}-10T deg{deg}')
 ax[1].set(xlim=(0,70),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='FFT amplitude'); ax[1].legend(fontsize=7); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/f'spot_{i}_fft.png',dpi=150); plt.show()
json.dump(results,open(out/'spot_results.json','w'),indent=2)

## HERA — resolve the electron onset before committing the fan

> **05:20** · Electron onset: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0; B 0.2→1.5 T, 363 uniform-1/B points; base T; Si 0 V · **ETA ~05:53** (≈33 min)

`sdh-spot-check` / `landau-fan` cost-floor prerequisite: run 6's onset is censored at 0.30 T, and its 50 mT grid below 1 T was explicitly background-only. This extension measures the same +3.2e12 cm^-2, D≈0 point with Δ(1/B)=0.01197 T^-1 (Nyquist 41.77 T, covering F_L=33.09 T plus 20% scale allowance), using the validated run-5 calibration and unchanged 3 s magnet settling (10τ at 24 dB/oct). It bridges 0.2–1.5 T to overlap run 6 and replaces the under-sampled onset segment; it is not evidence for a stacking call alone.

SAFETIES cell 18 [10] and VERIFY cell 32 [17] match all card limits; same-kernel handoff cells 44–46 confirm base T, zero gates/field, grant/binding retained. Preconditions re-read validators, base thermometry/freshness, heaters off, PS/output, drive and acquisition settings before writes; Si stays at zero. Ramp budget from 0 to 1.5 T is 1.5×7.3=10.95 min; measured run-6/7 overhead ≈3.08 s/field point gives 18.6 min, plus gate positioning, liveness and margin → 33 min. No ramp-rate or safety changes.

Checkpoint: inspect the first 10 points for current, leakage, clipping and temperature, then at 15 min and completion. Stop on |gate current|>1 nA, off-base temperature or clipping. A kernel interrupt stops acquisition, but this VTI supply finishes its current target; re-read field after any abort. Leave field at 1.5 T and gates at this point for the ensuing fan direction decision. The full fan will be committed after this onset read, with both Nyquist axes and model partner-period budget computed.

# sdh-spot-check: resolve censored electron onset before sizing the fan.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
for _name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
print(f'Expected base T 1.0–1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K, B≈0, Si=0: actual {_Ts}, {_Tv}, {_B}, {k_si()}')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
print('Expected heaters off and magnet PS/output on:', heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range(), magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled())
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
for _p, _bounds in [(k_tg.volt,(-.3,1.)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.)),(dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),(magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    _actual = (float(_p.vals._min_value),float(_p.vals._max_value))
    print(_p.full_name, 'expected',_bounds,'actual',_actual)
    assert _actual == _bounds
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10. and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.
print('Expected drive 1V/13.777Hz, tau .3s/24dB, NPLC 1:',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr1.time_constant(),sr1.filter_slope(),k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1.) < 1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.01
assert sr0.time_constant()==.3 and sr1.time_constant()==.3
assert sr0.filter_slope()==24 and sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert magnet.settle_s >= 3.0
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
_vt,_vb = calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
k_tg.volt.validate(_vt); k_bg.volt.validate(_vb)
B_vec = field_invB(.2,1.5,363)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_vec))) < 1/(2*40.)
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
mc=dict(meas_config);mc.update({'Si (V)':k_si(),'sample_temperature:':_Ts,'comments':'Electron onset extension n=+3.2e12 D=0; 0.2→1.5T uniform 1/B 363pts; run-5 calibration; 3s magnet settle, 50uV sr1'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,_vb);s.ramp(k_tg.volt,_vt)
interruptible_sleep(10)
# [time,B,T_sample,T_vaporizer,Itg,Ibg,sr0X,sr0P,sr1X,sr1P]
for _p in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P):
    s.fp(_p);s.plot('time',_p)
_onset_trip=[]
def onset_guard(station,data):
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(data)) or not 1.0<=data[2]<=1.5 or data[3]>=1.6 or max(abs(data[4]),abs(data[5]))>1e-9 or abs(data[8])>.9*50e-6:
        _onset_trip.append(list(data)); print('STOP: onset quality/thermal/leakage guard',data);station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('Actual endpoint:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),T_sample())
assert not _onset_trip, 'Onset sweep stopped; inspect actual state before another move'

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).

              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)

s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:

        station.interrupt_requested = True

# === SdH spot check, hole side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = -1.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), rides the magnet 10 -> 0.3 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = -1.2, 0.0                      # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm (D = 0 line reaches -1.27 on this side)
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (expect 10 T: the electron spot check ended there), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0 - 10.0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B, descending (blocking magnet; start where it sits). F_L(1.2e12) = 12.4 T.
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(10.0, 0.2999, -0.02), 4))[::-1]   # 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

# === Kernel-binding probe (read-only) ===
# First E1 act after the grant: confirms the nb-collab execute path lands on the
# operator's instrument-carrying kernel (the one that ran Setup + SAFETIES), not
# a fresh python3 kernel. Touches no instrument — namespace only.
import os
_need = ['magnet', 'heater', 'sr0', 'sr1', 'sr2', 'sr3', 'k_2400_tg', 'k_2400_bg',
         'dc205', 'k_tg', 'k_bg', 'k_si', 'T_sample', 'T_vaporizer', 'meas_config',
         'WIRING', 'state0', 'cal', 'B_SESSION_CAP', 'T_SESSION_CAP', 'tg_lims', 'bg_lims']
_missing = [n for n in _need if n not in globals()]
print(f"pid {os.getpid()} | main_dir {main_dir if 'main_dir' in globals() else '<unset>'}")
print(f"present: {len(_need) - len(_missing)}/{len(_need)} | missing: {_missing}")
print("KERNEL PROBE:", "BOUND" if not _missing else "UNBOUND")
